purpose: Set a boundary in time, conditions, knowledge, or effort.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
V dictionary / Vている / Vない + 限り; Nの + 限り
As long as the trains are running, there is a way home.
As far as I know, this shop is open on Sundays too.
I called for help at the top of my voice.
formation: V dictionary / Vている / Vない + 限り; Nの + 限り
restrictions: Meaning depends on the boundary: as long as, as far as, or to the limit.
mistake: State which kind of limit the context supplies.
